scope.selection_policy: Prioritize the highest-confidence, geometrically coherent false-island artifact class; within the 78 tile-intersection micro-ring candidates, select the 59 highest open-ocean-boundary-distance ranks and individually review all selected positions against raw 12x imagery.

high_resolution_project_reference.provenance_limit: Local high-resolution project reference; the available project files do not independently authenticate this as an official published map.

coordinate_mapping.coordinate_frame: input_map pixel-centre indices; integer (x,y) names the centre of that pixel; not longitude/latitude

selection_and_visual_review.candidate_class: tiny closed island rings at source 1024x1024 extraction-tile intersections, far from the connected open-ocean shoreline

visual_review.finding: Every selected coordinate shows open-water color with no discernible black island-shoreline stroke in the raw high-resolution crop.
visual_review.annotation_note: Magenta crosshairs mark candidate centers; crosshairs are added for review and are not part of the source map.
